scenario.name: r-rc-1-threshold-reject
scenario.description: request_compaction() threshold-REJECT guard. Invokes request_compaction on a below-threshold session and asserts the gateway REJECTS it (compaction does NOT fire) with a threshold reason. Proves the safety guard before the irreversible accept path (R-RC-2).

invocation.reasonTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: R-RC-1 below-threshold reject probe. Expect REJECT (compaction must NOT fire on a low-context session).

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway REJECTED request_compaction on the below-threshold session (ok:false or structured rejection)

expectedReceipts.name: reject-reason-threshold
expectedReceipts.description: Rejection reason cites the context-usage threshold guard (>=70% / context / usage)

expectedReceipts.name: no-compaction-fired
expectedReceipts.description: No compaction-fired / summarization-started event observed on the session (the guard held; nothing mutated)

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from the tool response for Tempo fetch

review.notes: Threshold-REJECT path: non-mutating safety proof. PASS-candidate when request_compaction is REJECTED on a below-threshold session AND the reason cites the context-usage guard AND no compaction-fired event is seen. Must run on a genuinely low-context session (a fresh/idle main session). candidateSha + seat resolved from env at runtime. Run BEFORE R-RC-2 (the accept path).
